axis_fifo.summary: AXI-Stream FIFO: packs sideband fields into a word written to a memory via MSB-wrapped pointers, read through a skid output pipeline; optional frame-mode drop logic.

blocks.name: Write side
blocks.description: Packs AXIS input fields, writes mem at write pointer when ready and valid.

anchors.name: s_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Input stream data packed into FIFO word.

anchors.name: s_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Input valid; with tready triggers memory write.

anchors.name: s_axis_tready
anchors.why: Input ready derived from full (or frame-mode flags).

anchors.name: s_axis
anchors.why: Packed input word {user,last,data} written to mem.

anchors.name: wr_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Committed write pointer; addresses mem writes, compared for full/empty.

anchors.name: s_axis_tlast
anchors.why: Frame end marker packed into word; ends frames in frame mode.

anchors.name: s_axis_tuser
anchors.why: User sideband packed into word; bad-frame marker.

anchors.name: mem
anchors.why: FIFO memory of packed AXIS words, written at wr_ptr, read at rd_ptr.

blocks.name: Full/empty logic
blocks.description: Pointer comparisons giving full and empty flags and status.

anchors.name: full
anchors.why: Pointer-compare full flag deasserting s_axis_tready.

anchors.name: empty
anchors.why: Pointer-equal empty flag gating reads and rd_ptr increment.

blocks.name: Output pipeline
blocks.description: Reads mem at read pointer into bubble-collapsing output stages.

anchors.name: rd_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Read pointer addressing mem, incremented when not empty.

anchors.name: m_axis_pipe_reg
anchors.why: Output pipeline stages carrying words from mem to m_axis.

anchors.name: m_axis_tvalid_pipe_reg
anchors.why: Per-stage valid bits of output pipeline, bubble collapse.

anchors.name: m_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Output data from last output pipeline stage.

anchors.name: m_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Output valid from last valid pipeline bit.

anchors.name: m_axis_tready
anchors.why: Output ready advances the output pipeline and memory read.

blocks.name: Frame drop control
blocks.description: Frame-mode speculative pointer, drop and frame status pulses.

anchors.name: wr_ptr_cur_reg
anchors.why: Frame-mode speculative write pointer (FRAME_FIFO disabled).

anchors.name: full_cur
anchors.why: Frame-mode full check against speculative pointer.

anchors.name: full_wr
anchors.why: Frame larger than FIFO overflow condition.

anchors.name: drop_frame_reg
anchors.why: Dropping current frame flag in frame mode.

anchors.name: overflow_reg
anchors.why: Pulse on dropped frame, drives status_overflow.

anchors.name: bad_frame_reg
anchors.why: Pulse on bad frame discarded, drives status_bad_frame.

anchors.name: good_frame_reg
anchors.why: Pulse on good frame committed, drives status_good_frame.

i2c_master.summary: I2C master: a byte-level command FSM consumes AXI-stream commands and data, driving a bit-level PHY FSM that generates start/stop/bit timing on SCL/SDA with a prescale delay counter.

blocks.name: Command FSM
blocks.description: Decodes commands, latches address and mode, sequences address/data bytes.

anchors.name: state_reg
anchors.why: Byte-level command FSM: address, write, read, stop sequencing; issues phy bit commands.

anchors.name: mode_read_reg
anchors.why: Latched read mode; sent as R/W bit and selects read vs write path.

anchors.name: mode_write_multiple_reg
anchors.why: Latched write-multiple mode, loops write until last byte.

anchors.name: mode_stop_reg
anchors.why: Latched stop request, issues stop after current transfer.

anchors.name: last_reg
anchors.why: Holds tlast of current write byte, ending write-multiple bursts.

anchors.name: addr_reg
anchors.why: Holds current slave address; shifted out bit by bit and compared to new commands.

anchors.name: s_axis_cmd_read
anchors.why: Read command bit selecting read mode in command FSM.

anchors.name: s_axis_cmd_write
anchors.why: Write command bit; triggers repeated start from active-read state.

anchors.name: s_axis_cmd_write_multiple
anchors.why: Write-multiple command, latched into mode_write_multiple_next.

anchors.name: s_axis_cmd_stop
anchors.why: Stop command bit; issues stop condition or sets mode_stop.

anchors.name: s_axis_cmd_start
anchors.why: Forces a repeated start condition.

blocks.name: PHY FSM
blocks.description: Generates SCL/SDA waveforms per bit command with clock stretching waits.

anchors.name: phy_state_reg
anchors.why: Bit-level PHY FSM generating start, stop, write and read bit waveforms on SCL/SDA.

anchors.name: phy_write_bit
anchors.why: Command from byte FSM to PHY FSM to transmit one bit.

anchors.name: phy_start_bit
anchors.why: Requests PHY to generate start or repeated start.

anchors.name: phy_stop_bit
anchors.why: Requests PHY to generate stop condition.

anchors.name: phy_read_bit
anchors.why: Requests PHY to sample one bit from SDA.

anchors.name: delay_scl_reg
anchors.why: Waits for SCL to go high, supporting clock stretching; stalls PHY FSM.

blocks.name: Bit timing
blocks.description: Prescale delay timer and bit counter for byte serialization.

anchors.name: delay_reg
anchors.why: Prescale delay timer stalling PHY FSM between SCL/SDA edges.

anchors.name: bit_count_reg
anchors.why: Counts address/data bits remaining; indexes addr_reg and data_reg.

anchors.name: prescale
anchors.why: Configures quarter-bit delay loaded into delay counter.

blocks.name: Shift datapath
blocks.description: Serializes write bytes onto SDA and deserializes read bits.

anchors.name: data_reg
anchors.why: Byte shift register: serializes write data and assembles read data bits.

anchors.name: phy_tx_data
anchors.why: Serial bit to transmit, selected from addr_reg, data_reg or ack.

anchors.name: phy_rx_data_reg
anchors.why: Sampled SDA bit, shifted into data_reg or used as ack.

blocks.name: Host AXI-stream interface
blocks.description: Command, write data and read data streams with registered handshakes.

anchors.name: s_axis_cmd_valid
anchors.why: Command stream valid; accepted with cmd_ready in idle/active states.

anchors.name: s_axis_cmd_ready
anchors.why: Command stream ready, registered from FSM state.

anchors.name: s_axis_cmd_address
anchors.why: 7-bit slave address of command, latched into addr_reg and compared for repeated start.

anchors.name: s_axis_data_tdata
anchors.why: Write data byte input loaded into data_reg for transmission.

anchors.name: s_axis_data_tvalid
anchors.why: Write data stream valid, gates loading data_reg in STATE_WRITE_1.

anchors.name: s_axis_data_tready
anchors.why: Write data stream ready, registered from FSM.

anchors.name: m_axis_data_tdata
anchors.why: Read data byte output assembled from received bits.

anchors.name: m_axis_data_tvalid
anchors.why: Read data valid, set when a byte is received, cleared by tready.

anchors.name: m_axis_data_tready
anchors.why: Read data stream ready clearing tvalid.

blocks.name: I2C pins
blocks.description: Open-drain SCL/SDA outputs and synchronized inputs.

anchors.name: scl_o
anchors.why: Generated I2C SCL output driven by PHY FSM.

anchors.name: sda_o
anchors.why: I2C SDA output carrying address/data bits and start/stop.

anchors.name: sda_i
anchors.why: SDA input synchronized into sda_i_reg for bit sampling and bus monitoring.

blocks.name: Bus monitor and status
blocks.description: Detects start/stop on bus and reports busy, bus_active, bus_control, missed_ack.

anchors.name: bus_active
anchors.why: Bus busy indication from start/stop detection; makes FSM wait in START_WAIT.

anchors.name: start_bit
anchors.why: Detected start condition on bus, sets bus_active_reg.

anchors.name: busy
anchors.why: Module busy status decoded from both FSM states.

anchors.name: bus_control
anchors.why: Indicates this master controls the bus.

anchors.name: missed_ack
anchors.why: Strobe when slave ack missing.

anchors.name: stop_on_idle
anchors.why: Configuration: auto-issue stop when no command pending.

i2c_master_axil.summary: AXI-Lite wrapper for an I2C master: decodes four registers (status, command, data, prescale) and pushes commands/write data through AXI-stream FIFOs into the i2c_master core, reading back data through a read FIFO.

blocks.name: AXI-Lite register interface
blocks.description: Decodes AXI-Lite writes/reads into status, command, data and prescale registers.

anchors.name: s_axil_awvalid
anchors.why: AXI-Lite write address valid; with wvalid starts a register write.

anchors.name: s_axil_awaddr
anchors.why: Write address decoded to status/command/data/prescale registers.

anchors.name: s_axil_wdata
anchors.why: Write data loaded into command, data and prescale fields.

anchors.name: s_axil_rdata
anchors.why: Register readback data: status bits, command, read FIFO data, prescale.

anchors.name: s_axil_wvalid
anchors.why: AXI-Lite write data valid, required with awvalid for a write.

anchors.name: s_axil_arvalid
anchors.why: AXI-Lite read address valid starting register readback.

anchors.name: s_axil_araddr
anchors.why: Read address selecting which register drives rdata.

anchors.name: s_axil_rvalid
anchors.why: Read data valid; blocks new reads until rready.

anchors.name: s_axil_bvalid
anchors.why: Write response valid; blocks further writes until bready.

anchors.name: s_axil_awready
anchors.why: Write address accept pulse.

anchors.name: s_axil_arready
anchors.why: Read address accept pulse.

anchors.name: s_axil_wstrb
anchors.why: Byte strobes gating which register fields are written.

blocks.name: Command register and FIFO
blocks.description: Command bits and address pushed through cmd_fifo_inst to the I2C core.

anchors.name: cmd_valid_reg
anchors.why: Pushes command word into command FIFO when any command bit written.

anchors.name: cmd_read_reg
anchors.why: Representative command bit (start/read/write/write_multiple/stop) packed into command FIFO.

anchors.name: cmd_address_reg
anchors.why: 7-bit I2C slave address held with command into command FIFO.

anchors.name: cmd_ready
anchors.why: Command FIFO ready; clears cmd_valid and flags overflow.

anchors.name: cmd_valid_int
anchors.why: Command FIFO output valid into i2c_master command port.

blocks.name: Write data FIFO
blocks.description: Write bytes with last flag buffered in write_fifo_inst.

anchors.name: data_in_reg
anchors.why: Write data byte pushed into write FIFO toward I2C core.

anchors.name: data_in_valid_reg
anchors.why: Write FIFO push valid set on data register write.

anchors.name: data_in_ready
anchors.why: Write FIFO ready; clears valid and flags write overflow.

anchors.name: data_in_last_reg
anchors.why: Last-byte marker for write_multiple pushed with data.

anchors.name: data_in_int
anchors.why: Write FIFO output byte into i2c_master data input.

blocks.name: Read data FIFO
blocks.description: Received bytes buffered in read_fifo_inst and popped on data register read.

anchors.name: data_out
anchors.why: Read FIFO output byte returned on data register read.

anchors.name: data_out_valid
anchors.why: Read FIFO has data; reported in data register bit 8.

anchors.name: data_out_ready_reg
anchors.why: Pops read FIFO after data register read.

anchors.name: data_out_int
anchors.why: Received byte from i2c_master into read FIFO.

blocks.name: Status and config registers
blocks.description: Prescale config plus sticky missed-ack/overflow and core status bits.

anchors.name: prescale_reg
anchors.why: Software-set SCL timing prescale fed to i2c_master.

anchors.name: missed_ack_reg
anchors.why: Sticky missed-ACK status bit, write-1-to-clear.

anchors.name: cmd_fifo_overflow_reg
anchors.why: Sticky command FIFO overflow status bit.

anchors.name: write_fifo_overflow_reg
anchors.why: Sticky write FIFO overflow status bit.

anchors.name: busy_int
anchors.why: I2C core busy reported in status register.

blocks.name: I2C master core
blocks.description: i2c_master instance executing commands on SCL/SDA.

anchors.name: i2c_sda_o
anchors.why: I2C SDA output driven by the i2c_master core.
